display.name: Shopify
display.blurb: Read and manage a Shopify store's products, orders, customers, and inventory via the Admin API — authenticated with a custom-app access token brokered at the egress proxy.

cli.doc:
Use `shopify` to drive a Shopify store's Admin API from this session — read/manage products, orders, customers, and inventory, or run arbitrary GraphQL. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the custom-app access token in the `X-Shopify-Access-Token` header on every request to *.myshopify.com; `SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login.

The store subdomain is NOT a secret — set `SHOPIFY_STORE` (e.g. `acme` for acme.myshopify.com) or pass `--store acme` once. The Admin API version (default 2026-01) rides the URL path; override with `SHOPIFY_API_VERSION` if needed.

Subcommands and the power each needs:
  shopify products [field=value ...]   List products (GET products.json) — needs products:read
  shopify product <id>                 Get one product — needs products:read
  shopify orders [field=value ...]     List orders (GET orders.json) — needs orders:read
  shopify customers [field=value ...]  List customers (GET customers.json) — needs customers:read
  shopify inventory [field=value ...]  List inventory levels — needs inventory:read
  shopify shop                         Shop info (GET shop.json) — read identity check, needs any read power
  shopify graphql '<query>' [JSON-vars]  Run a GraphQL query/mutation (POST graphql.json) — needs shopify:graphql
  shopify get  <path> [field=value ...]  Raw GET  under /admin/api/<version>/<path>
  shopify post <path> [JSON-body]        Raw POST under /admin/api/<version>/<path>
  shopify api  <METHOD> <path> [body]    Raw call, any method

Paths are relative to /admin/api/<version>/ (omit the leading slash). REST resources end in `.json` (e.g. `shopify get products/123.json`). Responses are JSON; auth failures return HTTP 401/403.
